title: No File, No Manifest
description: An admin fires off the CSV import request but forgets to attach the file. The API shouldn't hang or 500 — it should say plainly that nothing was uploaded.
successCondition: POST /api/admin/shipments/import as admin, sent as multipart/form-data with no file field present at all, returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR and a message indicating no file was uploaded.
hints: You still need a valid multipart Content-Type on the request even though the file part itself is absent — an empty JSON body won't exercise this path.
Compare this against sending a file field that contains a header row but zero data rows, which is a different (valid, 0-row) case.
